title: Mail
description: Mail — one inbox. Encrypted NOSTR direct messages over the internet and the Reticulum mesh.
summary: The unified messenger: every private message is a NOSTR encrypted note (kind-4, NIP-04) addressed to a person's key, not to a network. The same message rides internet relays and the Reticulum mesh at once — whichever arrives first wins, and the duplicates are folded away — so a conversation keeps working when one of them is down. Conversations are keyed by identity, so a callsign is only a nickname for a key.
